description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing in a Git repository. It defines functions and runs tests related to large pack files, such as creating many packs, measuring revision listing performance, and simulating pack loading, primarily for benchmarking Git's pack management capabilities.

methods.name: repack_into_n
methods.description: Creates a synthetic scenario with a specified number of pack files by generating commits and packing objects accordingly to simulate large repository states.

search-terms: performance with large numbers of packs
